g_pocket_all.description: any residue within 4.0 A of ATP or the divalent cation

g_pocket_adenine.description: within 4.0 A of the ATP adenine ring

g_pocket_phosphate.description: within 4.0 A of the ATP alpha/beta/gamma phosphates

g_pocket_metal.description: within 4.0 A of the divalent cation

f_pocket_all.description: within 4.0 A of ADP/Pi/Mg in >=50% of protomers

f_protomer_interface.description: within 4.5 A of a neighbouring protomer in >=50% of protomers that have any inter-protomer contact

catalytic_residues.reference: standard actin numbering, verified against PDB 2BTF SEQRES

nucleotide_cleft_variant_enrichment.caveat: n is small and the variant set is not an unbiased sample, so this is suggestive only; UniProt annotates A245T, G246A and G362R as 'uncertain significance'.
